aspect: Post-traumatic play is repetitive and joyless
description: Ordinary play is generative. Post-traumatic play repeats the same sequence without resolution, which is diagnostic, and which adults reliably misinterpret as morbid interest.
energy_note: A game that never gets to the end.

description: Play needs space, other children, and a level of adult inattention that is not available in a shelter. Removing the space removes the mechanism.
energy_note: No corner of the world left that is theirs.

aspect: Where it is used deliberately it works
description: The school-based Better Learning Programme treated 1,093 war-exposed students in over 100 Gaza schools; roughly half reported no nightmares after treatment and a further 47% reported reduced frequency.
energy_note: Cheap, school-based, and it actually worked.
notes: One of the few unambiguously positive findings in this dataset.

aspect: Adolescents get no equivalent at all
description: Programmes target under-twelves. Adolescents, who are simultaneously processing the war and forming an identity in it, are largely unserved, and are the group that goes on to fight in the next one.
energy_note: The age nobody builds a programme for.
